ns2:section.sectionText: Introduction to the analysis of time-to-event outcomes. Topics include censoring, discrete survival, parametric models, nonparametric one- and K-sample methods, Cox regression, regression diagnostics, time-dependent covariates, and multivariate survival outcomes. Emphasis on key underlying concepts and practical implementation. Prerequisites: STAT 410 and knowledge of R. Recommended: STAT 420. Restricted to Statistics Graduate Students until May 5, 2014. Some seats are reserved for incoming Statistics graduate students. If you receive a Reserved-Closed error, that means the course is full except for the reserved seats.
